text:
An aluminium block has a mass of 200g.
The specific heat capacity of aluminium is 900J/(kg°C).
How much energy is needed to increase the temperature of the block from 20°C to 110°C?
A
2.0J
B
2000J
C
16200J
D
16200000J
subject: Physics
